Name: NPCs Renamed
Author: Blams
Description:
By default the names aren't changed

To change an NPC's name you'll have to go in the mod options or the config file. You can change a name in the save while you're playing it with Generic Mod Config and the game will update on changing locations.

(Not available for the Wizard as it breaks SVE so I took it out)

Downloads.Description: Removed Wizard rename option, fixed Penny bug
